name: oh-my-tex
description: Edit LaTeX prose and formulas on one page: formulas become in-place visual math fields, the .tex source stays authoritative.

oh-my-tex.completion.acceptOnEnter.description: Accept completion candidates with Enter in prose and formulas. When disabled, Tab accepts candidates and Enter keeps its normal editor behavior.

oh-my-tex.macros.markdownDescription: Extra math macros, e.g. `{ "\\R": "\\mathbb{R}", "\\norm": { "args": 1, "def": "\\left\\lVert#1\\right\\rVert" } }`. Project `\newcommand`s are discovered automatically.

oh-my-tex.renderMacros.markdownDescription: Display-only math macro overrides, using the same format as `oh-my-tex.macros`, e.g. `{ "\\slashed": { "args": 1, "def": "\\cancel{#1}" } }`. These take priority over project macros, compatibility macros and MathLive commands. They do not add completion items or change LaTeX source.

oh-my-tex.templates.markdownDescription: Formula templates offered by completion. Each item: `{ "prefix": "\\sumn", "label": "sum over n", "body": "\\sum_{${1:n=1}}^{${2:N}} $0", "context": "math" }`. Body uses VS Code snippet syntax.

oh-my-tex.math.inlineShortcuts.description: Enable a small set of symbolic inline shortcuts (<=, >=, !=, ->). Configure additional shortcuts with math.inlineShortcutOverrides.

oh-my-tex.math.inlineShortcutOverrides.markdownDescription: Add or override inline math shortcuts, e.g. `{ "alpha": "\\alpha" }`. An empty value disables a default shortcut. Applied when `math.inlineShortcuts` is enabled.

oh-my-tex.math.completionAllowPatterns.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular-expression sources for additional formula completions. Patterns match the label, filter text or inserted LaTeX. Invalid patterns are ignored. MathLive commands, project macros and math templates are always included.

oh-my-tex.workshop.nativeEditorColumn.description: Where the native source editor opens when bridging to LaTeX Workshop (SyncTeX, root detection).

oh-my-tex.workshop.returnToVisualEditor.description: Return focus to the visual editor after forward SyncTeX. Disable to keep the native source editor active.

oh-my-tex.workshop.primeRoot.markdownDescription: Activate the project root in a native editor before Workshop actions. Workshop has no silent public root-refresh API; use Sync Workshop Root and View PDF for an explicit refresh. A % !TeX root comment is recommended for multi-root workspaces.
